name: Keboola MCP Server
description: Lets AI agents query Keboola storage, build SQL transformations, run jobs, and manage flows and data apps in a Keboola project over a hosted OAuth or local MCP server.

skills.name: Storage Query
skills.description: Queries tables directly and reads or updates table and bucket descriptions in project storage.

skills.name: SQL Transformations
skills.description: Creates SQL transformations from natural-language descriptions.

skills.name: Job Runs
skills.description: Runs components and transformations and retrieves job execution details.

skills.name: Flow Building
skills.description: Builds and manages Conditional Flows and Orchestrator Flows for pipelines.

skills.name: Development Branches
skills.description: Scopes every operation to a selected development branch so changes stay out of production.
